title: The Great Hunt: The Yearling

texts.details:
Barnil's hunter. I had word you might come. Sit by the water. Not too near it.

You have hunted what charges, what stalks, what thinks, and what thinks as well as you. The fifth beast is none of these. It is simply the largest hunter that has ever walked this world. Most of its kind died long ago. They live on only in a few lost places, and this crater is one.

You will not take a grown one alone. No one does. But there is a yearling in the Marshlands north of here, driven out by its mother, already the height of a kodo. First, learn what lives beside such a thing. Take eight of the ravasaurs. See how even they keep looking over their shoulders.
texts.objectives: Kill 8 Ravasaurs in the Marshlands of Un'Goro Crater and then the Yearling, a young devilsaur. Return to Torwa Pathfinder.
texts.progress: You will feel it in the ground before you see it. Trust the ground.
texts.completion:
The Yearling. You have done a thing most hunters only tell lies about.

Look at what you brought back, and what you left. That is the fifth teaching. When the prey is that great, nothing of it may be wasted: not the hide, not the sinew. A careless hunter takes one skin from a beast. One who has faced the devilsaur learns to take all there is. You will find your knife surer from this day.

One beast remains. It is far to the north, in the snows of Winterspring. In the goblin town of Everlook, find Storm Shadowhoof. Go when you have sixty seasons of sense. And know this, $N: the last hunt is not for a kill.

idea: The Great Hunt, level 50: the devilsaur. From the wiki: devilsaurs are among the largest predators ever to walk Azeroth, most died out long ago, and some survive in isolated pockets such as Un'Goro. Gives the perk of more from skinning. Invented: the Yearling.
